props.name: source
props.comment: The form field holding the address text.

props.name: latSource
props.comment: Written with the picked result's latitude. Left alone when unset.

props.name: lngSource
props.comment: Written with the picked result's longitude. Left alone when unset.

props.name: bboxSource
props.comment: Written with the picked result's `[west, south, east, north]`, when it has one.

props.name: label
props.comment: A string is translated; `false` renders none. Defaults to the label of `source`.

props.name: provider
props.comment: Defaults to the `geocoder` of `MapsProvider`. One of the two is required.

props.name: minChars
props.comment: Shortest trimmed query that searches. Defaults to 3.

props.name: debounceMs
props.comment: Typeahead providers only: wait after the last key. Defaults to 300.
